tidal.preferences.keybind.title: Tidal Keybind
tidal.preferences.keybind.description: The keybind used to open the Tidal menu.
tidal.preferences.keybind_closes_gui.des: Pressing the Tidal keybind while the menu or HUD editor is open closes it, instead of switching between the two.
tidal.preferences.hud_settings_keybind.d: Opens the settings panel for the currently selected HUD in the HUD editor.
tidal.preferences.hud_visibility_keybind: Toggles the visibility of the currently selected HUDs in the HUD editor.
tidal.preferences.hud_lock_keybind.title: Lock/Unlock HUD
tidal.preferences.hud_lock_keybind.descr: Locks or unlocks the currently selected HUDs in the HUD editor.
tidal.preferences.hud_copy_keybind.title: Copy HUD
tidal.preferences.hud_copy_keybind.descr: Copies the currently selected HUDs in the HUD editor to the clipboard.
tidal.preferences.hud_cut_keybind.title: Cut HUD
tidal.preferences.hud_cut_keybind.descri: Copies the currently selected HUDs in the HUD editor to the clipboard and deletes them.
tidal.preferences.hud_paste_keybind.desc: Pastes the HUDs from the clipboard into the HUD editor at the pointer position.
Duplicates the currently selected HUD in the HUD editor.
tidal.preferences.hud_reset_keybind.desc: Resets all properties of the currently selected HUDs in the HUD editor.
tidal.preferences.hud_delete_keybind.des: Deletes the currently selected HUDs in the HUD editor.
tidal.preferences.hud_select_all_keybind: Selects all unlocked HUDs in the HUD editor.
tidal.preferences.hud_show_keybind_hints: Shows the keyboard shortcut next to each action in the HUD editor context menu.
tidal.preferences.hud_marquee_anim.title: Selection Box Animation
tidal.preferences.hud_marquee_anim.descr: Fades the selection rectangle in and out when drag-selecting HUDs in the editor.
tidal.preferences.hud_marquee_anim_durat: The duration of the fade animation for the drag selection rectangle in milliseconds.
tidal.preferences.background_blur.title: Background Blur
tidal.preferences.background_blur.descri: Blurs the full game background when the Tidal menu is open.
tidal.preferences.hud_drag_ui_opacity.de: How visible the Tidal menu stays while you drag a HUD. 0 = fully transparent, 1 = no fade.
tidal.preferences.page_opacity.title: Page Opacity
tidal.preferences.page_opacity.descripti: How opaque the Tidal content panel background is. 0 = fully transparent, 100 = fully opaque.
tidal.preferences.sidebar_opacity.title: Sidebar Opacity
tidal.preferences.sidebar_opacity.descri: How opaque the Tidal sidebar background is. 0 = fully transparent, 100 = fully opaque.
tidal.preferences.glow_opacity.title: Background Glow Opacity
tidal.preferences.glow_opacity.descripti: How strong the accent-coloured glow behind the Tidal menu is. 0 = hidden, 100 = fully opaque.
tidal.preferences.pause_game.title: Pause Game
tidal.preferences.pause_game.description: Pause singleplayer worlds while the Tidal menu is open.
tidal.preferences.reduced_res_filter.des: Counteracts blur when the game renders at a reduced resolution (e.g. Sodium Extra's 'Reduce Resolution on macOS'). Only takes effect when the display is upscaling a reduced framebuffer. 'Sharpen' softly crisps the whole menu; 'Harden edges' aliases text/edges so they survive the upscale like Minecraft's font (crisper text, but blockier corners).
tidal.preferences.ui_sharpening.title: Filter strength
tidal.preferences.ui_sharpening.descript: How strongly to apply the reduced-resolution filter. Higher is crisper but can add halos (Sharpen) or jagged edges (Harden).
tidal.preferences.opening_behavior.title: Opening Behavior
tidal.preferences.opening_behavior.descr: Which page to open when the Tidal menu is launched.
tidal.preferences.restore_hud_editor.des: Reopens the HUD editor instead of the Tidal menu when the HUD editor was the last page you closed.
tidal.preferences.show_opening_page_anim: Plays the page animation when the menu is first opened.
tidal.preferences.instant_search.title: Instant Search
tidal.preferences.instant_search.descrip: Focuses the search bar when the Tidal menu opens.
tidal.preferences.show_option_action_but: Shows a more actions button on active option rows. Right-click options still opens the same menu.
Moves the Edit HUD and Global Search buttons to the bottom of the sidebar, above your account.
tidal.preferences.time_before_reset.desc: Seconds of inactivity before the smart reset returns to the default page.
tidal.preferences.search_distance.title: Search Distance
tidal.preferences.search_distance.descri: The maximum Levenshtein distance used when fuzzy-matching search queries.
tidal.preferences.opening_animation.desc: Plays an animation when opening the Tidal menu.
tidal.preferences.closing_animation.desc: Plays an animation when closing the Tidal menu.
tidal.preferences.opening_time.title: Opening Time
tidal.preferences.opening_time.descripti: Duration of the opening and closing animations, in seconds.
tidal.preferences.ui_sounds.title: UI Sounds
tidal.preferences.ui_sounds.description: Play sound effects when interacting with the Tidal menu and HUD designer.
tidal.preferences.menu_sounds.title: Menu Sounds
tidal.preferences.menu_sounds.descriptio: Play sounds when opening and closing Tidal screens.
tidal.preferences.click_sounds.title: Click Sounds
tidal.preferences.click_sounds.descripti: Play sounds when clicking Tidal controls.
tidal.preferences.slider_sounds.title: Slider Sounds
tidal.preferences.slider_sounds.descript: Play tick sounds when dragging sliders and ordered lists.
tidal.preferences.hud_editor_sounds.desc: Play sounds when selecting, dragging, and resizing HUD elements.
tidal.preferences.ui_ambience.title: UI Ambience
tidal.preferences.ui_ambience.descriptio: Play a soft ambient loop while the Tidal menu or HUD designer is open.
tidal.preferences.duck_music.title: Duck Music During Ambience
tidal.preferences.duck_music.description: Lower Minecraft music while Tidal ambience is playing.
tidal.preferences.ui_sound_volume.title: UI Sound Volume
tidal.preferences.ui_sound_volume.descri: Volume of Tidal's UI sound effects.
tidal.preferences.page_animation_duratio: Duration of page transition animations, in seconds.
tidal.preferences.show_first_launch_mess: Show the welcome message the first time Tidal is launched.
tidal.notification.first_launch.title: Welcome to Tidal!
tidal.notification.first_launch.message: Press '%s' to open Tidal and access all your mod settings in one place.
tidal.itemlist.title: Select items
tidal.itemlist.catalog_unavailable: The Minecraft item catalog is unavailable
